title: The Unified Voice | ECHO//100 Episode 16
description: Kavi loses control as the administrative codes of the city begin to rewrite reality itself. Mira must confront the source of his corruption before the timeline dissolves into nothingness. Episode 16 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction production.

scenes.text: Kavi rises into the air, his red hoodie fluttering against the shifting geometry of the void.
scenes.caption: Kavi levitates, reality warping
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses floating in a geometric purple void, background architecture folding like paper, cinematic vertical shot.

scenes.text: He shouts a command, forcing the walls of the pocket dimension to fold inward like origami.
scenes.caption: Architecture collapses inward
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi with glowing purple eyes pointing at folding walls, floating debris, dark void aesthetic, vertical composition.

scenes.text: Mira draws her teal coat tight, realizing Kavi is not just possessed, but physically overwriting history.
scenes.caption: Mira watches in horror
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in a glowing holographic teal coat looking up at Kavi, distressed expression, purple static particles floating around her.

scenes.text: Within the static, a jagged silhouette emerges; Null is not a monster, but Kavi’s buried guilt.
scenes.caption: Null is Kavi's guilt
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's face transitioning into a glitching black-purple figure, red eyes flickering, split personality visual.

scenes.text: The archive memories flood Kavi’s mind, forcing him to witness every hour he ever lost before.
scenes.caption: Memories overwhelm Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his head, purple light emanating from his backpack and eyes, distorted reality in background.

scenes.text: Byte ignores his core programming directives, lunging forward to shield Kavi from the encroaching, hungry void.
scenes.caption: Byte defies his code
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with a cyan face and orange antenna, positioning himself protectively in front of Kavi.

scenes.text: The separation begins as the dark energy peels away from the red door, forming a solid shape.
scenes.caption: Null separates from architecture
scenes.image_prompt: A black-purple glitch entity pulling itself away from a glowing red door, taking on a humanoid form.

scenes.text: Null stands fully formed, eyes locking onto Kavi in a silent, terrifying confrontation of two selves.
scenes.caption: Null confronts Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi face-to-face with the fully manifested Null figure, intense contrast, glowing purple and red lighting, vertical frame.
